ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens: loose leaves in light green, dark green, and deep burgundy-purple, with ruffled edges and some crisp leaf veins, scattered across most of the bowl with slight moisture, no dressing sheen visible | 60
ITEM 2 | Pan-seared cheese: four or five cubes/slabs about 3 cm across and 1.5 cm tall, white interior with firm, slightly crumbly edges, golden-brown seared crust with darker flecks on the top and sides, dry surface, resting on and among the greens in the upper-left and center of the bowl | 75
